metadata.article_title: Effect of failure to comply with order.

article.title: Effect of failure to comply with order.
article.content:
Where the appellant fails to comply with such order, the proceedings shall be stayed,
and the appeal shall not proceed without an order in this behalf of, 1[the Supreme Court], and in the meantime execution of the decree appealed from shall not be stayed.
article.html:
11Effect of failure to comply with order.

Order 45, Rule 11

Where the appellant fails to comply with such order, the proceedings shall be stayed,

and the appeal shall not proceed without an order in this behalf of, 1[the Supreme Court], and in the meantime execution of the decree appealed from shall not be stayed.

1 Added by Act 26 of 1920, s. 3.
